name: How long does a repipe after a slab leak typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a repipe after a slab leak typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a repipe after a slab leak varies based on the size of your home and the complexity of the plumbing system. Generally, it can take anywhere from 3 to 7 days. During the process, water service may be intermittently shut off, but our team at CG Plumbing Solutions works to minimize disruption. We provide a detailed timeline upfront, allowing you to prepare for the temporary changes to your daily routine, such as arranging for water supply or alternative accommodation if preferred.
acceptedAnswer.description: A repipe typically takes 3 to 7 days, depending on home size and system complexity. Water service may be intermittently affected during this time.
